title: Log Boats
description: Changes all boats to look like carved logboats
body:
![Boats](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/57e72e69749fc5aa72e4d43c86bba2edee2c1a33.png)
Small boats should be carved from wood logs.
If you aggree this is the resource pack for you,
All vanilla boats, chestboats, aswell as the boats from the Quark mod are changed to reflect this idea.
Inventory items are also changed.

Best paired with a WIP datapack that changes the boat recipe to use logs:
(WIP)

Usage in modpacks is allowed.

Compatible with quark.
Other modded boats will be made compatible later.
